title: Window-Local Utilities
description: All utilities are local to the window instance. Only tools are mode-wide. Fix puzzle 3D transform activating gumball across all windows by carrying per-window activeUtilityByWindowId on ViewState and stamping each window's utility during refreshUi.
summary:
Fixed utilities leaking across window instances during batched refreshUi. The shell already stored per-window utilities in activeUtilityByWindowId, but refresh injected only the focused window's utility into a shared ViewState used for every pane render — causing puzzle 3D transform/gumball (and other utility-driven scene state) to appear in all panes.

Changes:
- framework/core (rs + js): added ViewState.activeUtilityByWindowId map; clarified activeUtilityId as per-call overlay; tools stay mode-wide via activeToolId.
- framework/renderer/react: buildActiveUtilityByWindowId helper; refreshUi passes the full utility map and clears singular activeUtilityId; actions still use injectActiveUtility for targeted window overlay.
- framework/plugin: plugin_refresh_ui stamps each window's active_utility_id from the map before render.
- puzzle/plugin: puzzle2d/3d/5d scene-active-utility helpers resolve per window instance; window_engagements/measures build envelopes inside per-wid loops with the correct utility.

Tests: vitest buildActiveUtilityByWindowId + refresh map forwarding (2/2 pass). Added puzzle3d transform_utility_is_local_to_the_window_instance_not_shared_across_split_panes Rust test. cargo check -p semio-framework-core and -p semio-framework-plugin pass in isolated target dir; puzzle-plugin lib has unrelated concurrent compile errors (missing presence fields) blocking full cargo test run.
